title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Google Gemini 4 Argon rolls out to AI Pro/Ultra subscribers (Oct 13)
bullets.summary: Available in the Gemini app, AI Mode and Antigravity; Google claims 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 with introductory API pricing of $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens (per AI Weekly roundup; vendor-claimed benchmark).
bullets.how: The Construct: benchmark Argon against current coding/agent models for cost-per-task before routing any work to it. PRAGMA: another option for client model-routing advice. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Anthropic ships 'preserved thinking' distillation defenses in Claude Fable 5.1 and Opus 5.5 (Oct 12)
bullets.summary: Anthropic says the safeguards cut data harvesting roughly 90-99% and that newer API accounts are blocked from editing prior context; tens of thousands of accounts were reportedly banned (secondhand via AI Weekly).
bullets.how: The Construct: agents that rewrite or replay prior context through the API may hit the new restrictions on newer accounts; check any context-editing flows. PRAGMA: note for client builds that depend on context manipulation. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full; Full ranks #2 on Artificial Analysis Index v4.3 behind Claude Opus 5.5
bullets.summary: Priced at $4 in / $20 out per 1M tokens, with 'Active Memory' and 'Active Focus' agent features; Wonder is on the Meta Model API and Muse Code, Full on Muse Code only.
bullets.how: The Construct: evaluate Muse Code as an alternate coding worker once API access exists for Full. PRAGMA: add Meta to the model-comparison table. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

bullets.title: Scuba exits stealth with $34M for an MCP-connected 'context engine' for agents
bullets.summary: Accel led the pre-seed and IVP co-led the seed; it shares content with AI agents through MCP connectors.
bullets.how: The Construct: watch as a possible shared-context layer across agents. PRAGMA: competitor/partner signal in agent infrastructure. Brand 9 Signs: no direct impact.

praxis_lesson: Platform vendors are tightening what agents can do with context and access (Anthropic's preserved-thinking limits, Google's agentic-client flag), so build agents that tolerate API-side restrictions and keep approval gates outside the model.
